title_en: Table 10.6 : PROPORTION OF TOURISM REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE TO CENTRAL GOVERNMENT BUDGET, 2006 - 2014
source: Source: Ministry of Finance and Treasury
notes: *Tourism Revenue: include Tourism tax, Resort lease rent (Resort kuli) until 2011
* 2011 onwards Tourism Goods and Services tax has been included in Total Revenue
* 2012 onwards lease period Extension fee has been included in Total Revenue
* Bed Tax was abolished from Dec 2014
* Green tax will be introduced starting Nov 2015
* TGST rate was increased from 8% to 12% starting Nov 2014

* lease period extension fee (consession fee for upto 50 years) was started in mid 2014 after a court ruling. LPEF will be paid in 6 installments, most of which fall for 2015. The last payment will be in March 2016.
